statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93271
The diagnosis codes listed are I48.0, I34.0, and I49.5

The patient has recurrent palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The patient has documented symptomatic paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has sick sinus syndrome
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service is clinically necessary to correlate symptoms with arrhythmic events

The service directly addresses the clinical concern
